snippet_primary: "Here at Domestika, various payment methods are enabled depending on where you are located*, this way you can complete your purchases in the way that best suits you! Below, you can find the details of each method: In order to enroll in Domestika's courses, you can make the payment with a credit or debit card (we accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discovery, JCB, UnionPay, Elo, Hipercard, BBVA Bancomer and Santander). Make sure your card is enabled to be used for online purchases in international stores."
